props.name: size
props.description: The size of the calendar.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined generated classes.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: class
props.description: Additional CSS class name.

props.name: showWeekNumbers
props.description: Whether to show week numbers.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale to use for formatting.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: The day that starts the week.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Whether the current selection is invalid according to application logic.

props.name: validationState
props.description: Validation state for backward-compatible Solid Stately callers.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error message to display when the calendar is invalid.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Custom aria label.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }

props.name: onChange
props.description: Handler called when the value changes.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Whether the calendar is disabled.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether dates outside the visible range are automatically focused.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value (controlled).

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Handler called when the focused date changes.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Whether single or multiple date selection is enabled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value (uncontrolled).

props.name: minValue
props.description: The minimum allowed date.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The maximum allowed date.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Whether the calendar is read-only.

props.name: focusedValue
props.description: The date that is focused when the calendar first mounts.

props.name: defaultFocusedValue
props.description: The default focused date (uncontrolled).

props.name: createCalendar
props.description: Creates a calendar object for a locale calendar identifier.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Callback that is called for each date in the calendar to determine if it is unavailable.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: The number of months to display at once.

props.name: pageBehavior
props.description: Controls whether paging advances by one month or by the visible month range.

props.name: selectionAlignment
props.description: Determines how the visible months align around the initial focused date.

props.name: autoFocusOnMount
props.description: Whether to automatically focus the calendar when it is mounted.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Controls which days are disabled.
